system.description:
The most common armor, worn by city guards and the like - typically pieces of leather, sometimes hardened by boiling, at other times quilted. Padding worn under other armor types counts as Light Armor when worn alone.

Negative Traits: None

Concealability: Can be concealed if specifically made to look like normal clothing (requires Resources x3), otherwise a long cloak is needed.

Availability: Resources x1, Common
system.source: Faith and Fire (Dark Ages), Rules, Systems and Drama
